Contact us directly

Email support@relocationmanagerusa.com. Include your account email, the page you were using, and what happened so the support team can investigate efficiently.

  • Billing problem or wrong charge: email us with the subject line Billing and include the email address on your account and the charge date. Never send your full card number. If we cannot resolve a charge, you can also dispute it with your card issuer.
  • Suspected fraud, scam, or suspicious load: email us with the subject line URGENT — Fraud report. Fraud reports are reviewed first, ahead of all other requests. Include screenshots and do not delete your messages — they are evidence.
  • Verification taking too long: email us with the subject line Verification and the email address you signed up with.
Suspected fraud or crime: Stop the transaction, preserve messages and documents, and contact the appropriate carrier, insurer, bank, law-enforcement agency, or regulator. The platform does not replace emergency, legal, insurance, or regulatory help.
